final: WITH rating_stock AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS films_in_stock FROM inventory AS i JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_average AS (SELECT AVG(films_in_stock) AS average_films FROM rating_stock) SELECT SUM(rs.films_in_stock) AS total_films_in_stock, AVG(rs.films_in_stock - ra.average_films) AS average_above_rating_average FROM rating_stock AS rs CROSS JOIN rating_average AS ra WHERE rs.films_in_stock > ra.average_films
